name: Tardigrade Cryptobiosis Modification
description: Introduces tardigrade cryptobiosis genes that allow the user to enter a state of suspended animation under extreme conditions. When triggered by severe dehydration, temperature extremes, or voluntary biochemical cascade, the body's metabolism drops to near zero — cells produce trehalose sugar glass that preserves cellular structures, proteins fold into protective configurations, and the user enters a death-like state that can persist for hours, days, or potentially weeks. The user appears dead by every conventional measurement — no heartbeat, no breathing, no neural activity. Revival requires specific environmental conditions (rehydration and warming) and takes 10–30 minutes. The modification is designed as a survival mechanism of last resort — when the alternative is death, suspended animation preserves the body until rescue. Helix Biosystems developed it for deep-space research applications that were never funded; the terrestrial version is marketed as 'biological life insurance.'
source_organism: Ramazzottius varieornatus (tardigrade), Artemia franciscana (brine shrimp, trehalose production)
legality: Licensed (legal status during suspension is unresolved — are you dead?)
procedure: Systemic retroviral rewrite with metabolic shutdown pathway installation, 15 sessions over 8 months
side_effects: Accidental activation during extreme cold or dehydration — user enters suspension unintentionally
Revival is not guaranteed — each suspension carries a 2–5% failure-to-revive risk
Memory loss of the 30–60 minutes before suspension
Post-revival confusion and weakness lasting 2–7 days
Legal complications — suspended users have been declared dead, their assets distributed, their identities reassigned
Psychological trauma from experiencing death-like unconsciousness
social_perception: Exotic, unsettling, and legally nightmarish. The modification raises questions about the definition of death that GLMZ's legal system has not resolved. Users who have been suspended and revived report existential disorientation. Family members who have watched a loved one 'die' and then return report lasting psychological damage.
story_hooks: A Tun State user is declared legally dead during an accidental suspension, and when they revive three weeks later, they discover their identity has been erased and their assets seized by a corponation that was waiting for exactly this

A series of 'dead' bodies in a the Gray Zone morgue begin reviving simultaneously — someone installed cryptobiosis modifications without the recipients' knowledge, suspended them, and stored them for a purpose that's now becoming clear
